# Continental Large-Load Interconnection & Telemetry Registry

Independent open-source research infrastructure contributing data, provenance, and reproducible tooling to AI 2040 Plan A Track 3 research.

## Stable public pages

- Main registry: https://anonrish.github.io/continental-load-registry/
- Track 3 Evidence Observatory: https://anonrish.github.io/continental-load-registry/track3.html
- AI 2040 Plan A / Track 3 research bridge: https://anonrish.github.io/continental-load-registry/plan-a.html

## Primary AI 2040 references

- Track 3: https://ai-2040.com/supplements/verification-plan/get-involved
- Plan A — Covert AI Projects: https://ai-2040.com/print/covert-ai-projects
- Plan A scenario: https://ai-2040.com/print/scenario?book=1&plan=A

## Scope

The repository is not an AI Futures Project publication, does not speak for AI 2040, and does not certify a treaty or verification regime. AI 2040 references should be cited separately from repository-derived observations.

## Current Track 3 evidence boundary

The repository currently preserves a 93-site Epoch frontier-AI site layer plus North American grid/connection evidence, selected site-level electricity and cooling observations, and aggregate global compute source snapshots. Several Plan A Track 3 elements remain partial or design-only, including full production reconciliation, transaction-level recursive transfer tracing, physical inspections, serial continuity, decommissioning/recycling verification, statistical sampling, untraced-pool accounting, and site-level remote sensing.

## Citation

AnonRish, Continental Large-Load Interconnection & Telemetry Registry: AI 2040 Plan A Track 3 research contribution, 2026.

For factual claims, cite the repository artifact and the underlying publisher/source that supports the claim.

## Map semantics

The main dashboard map separates core queue/facility rows, project-level records, Epoch AI site observations, connection-research targets, and aggregate/historical footprints. A map point with county/city/state precision is display geometry and is not evidence of a street-level facility location or queue membership.

- Unified public-data catalog: https://github.com/AnonRish/continental-load-registry/blob/main/data/public_data_catalog.json
